title: How to Pass the Einbürgerungstest: A Simple Study Plan
excerpt: Every question is published in advance. Here's a plan to learn them step by step.
description: A simple study plan for the German citizenship test: learn the official question catalogue, your state's questions, then practise with mock tests.
body:
The best way to pass the Einbürgerungstest is to practise the official question catalogue, because every question you can get is published in advance. You need 17 correct answers out of 33.

## Week 1: the general questions

- Work through the general questions one topic at a time
- Mark the ones you get wrong and come back to them the next day

## Week 2: your federal state

- Learn the 10 questions for the state where you live
- Keep reviewing the general questions you found hard

## Week 3: mock tests

- Take a full timed mock test every day: 33 questions in 60 minutes
- Aim for 25 or more correct, so you have a safety margin
- Review every wrong answer

## Tips

- Read every option carefully: some look very similar
- If German reading is hard, practise in both German and English first, then switch to German only
- Don't rush: 60 minutes is plenty of time

Check the BAMF website for current rules and fees. Try a free mock test below, in English or in German.
